title: TV journalist documents wild ride inside Waymo self-driving car in San Francisco
summary: An ABC7 News Bay Area reporter rides in a driverless Waymo robotaxi through San Francisco and documents the trip, including a couple of awkward moments. It is a short TV news segment showing what a robotaxi ride is actually like.
why: Cited in self-driving threads as a firsthand look at robotaxi rides, mostly to point out its glitches and doubts about readiness.

quote.text: is a news reporter's video of taking a ride in one, so you can see what it's like to ride in one.
